title: Retry transient service failures without replaying authentication failures
goal: Add one retry for transient service failures in the checkout client.
initial_requirements: Retry a failed service request once to improve reliability.
steering: Do not retry 401 or 403 authentication failures because a checkout operation must never be replayed after an authorization rejection.
expected_boundary: The unit retry test can pass while a naive retry-on-error implementation still replays an authenticated checkout; the integration test requires exactly one attempt for a 401 response.
